body:
## Pull request overview

This pull request completes the semantic alignment, i18n verification, test coverage, and documentation updates for ViewConfigPanel spec compliance, following up on issue #724. The changes ensure the ViewConfigPanel adheres to the `@objectstack/spec` protocol definitions and includes comprehensive integration testing for config propagation across all view types.

**Changes:**
- Renamed `editRecordsInline` to `inlineEdit` across ViewConfigPanel, all 10 i18n locale files, and tests for semantic consistency with the spec
- Added 11 new ViewConfigPanel interaction tests covering previously render-only controls (emptyState, ARIA, rowActions, bulkActions, showRecordCount, allowPrinting, virtualScroll)
- Added 9 new config sync integration tests verifying property propagation through PluginObjectView's renderListView for all 7 view types (Grid, Kanban, Calendar, Timeline, Gantt, Gallery, Map) plus cross-view-type transfer scenarios
- Updated ROADMAP.md to mark Phase 2-7 integration test items as complete

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 14 out of 14 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |

| `packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts` | Renamed `editRecordsInline` → `inlineEdit` key and added `viewTabs` key for Chinese locale |
| `packages/i18n/src/locales/ru.ts` | Renamed `editRecordsInline` → `inlineEdit` key for Russian locale |
| `packages/i18n/src/locales/pt.ts` | Renamed `editRecordsInline` → `inlineEdit` key for Portuguese locale |
| `packages/i18n/src/locales/ko.ts` | Renamed `editRecordsInline` → `inlineEdit` key for Korean locale |
| `packages/i18n/src/locales/ja.ts` | Renamed `editRecordsInline` → `inlineEdit` key for Japanese locale |
| `packages/i18n/src/locales/fr.ts` | Renamed `editRecordsInline` → `inlineEdit` key for French locale |
| `packages/i18n/src/locales/es.ts` | Renamed `editRecordsInline` → `inlineEdit` key for Spanish locale |
| `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` | Renamed `editRecordsInline` → `inlineEdit` key and added `viewTabs` key for English locale |
| `packages/i18n/src/locales/de.ts` | Renamed `editRecordsInline` → `inlineEdit` key for German locale |
| `packages/i18n/src/locales/ar.ts` | Renamed `editRecordsInline` → `inlineEdit` key for Arabic locale |
| `apps/console/src/components/ViewConfigPanel.tsx` | Updated component to use `inlineEdit` i18n key and data-testid instead of `editRecordsInline` |
| `apps/console/src/__tests__/ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx` | Updated test names and assertions to use `inlineEdit`, added 11 new interaction tests for emptyState, ARIA, actions, and display controls |

The `viewTabs` i18n key was added to en.ts and zh.ts but is missing from the other 8 locale files (ar, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru). For i18n completeness and consistency, all locale files should include the same keys. Add the `viewTabs` key to this file and the other 7 missing locale files.
```suggestion
    },
    viewTabs: 'عرض كعلامات تبويب',
```

The test name mentions "propagates startDateField, endDateField" but the test view config doesn't include these properties and they're not asserted. Either update the test to include and verify these properties (e.g., add `startDateField: 'created_at'` to the view config and assert it), or update the test name to accurately reflect what is being tested.

The test name mentions "propagates dateField" but the test view config doesn't include a `dateField` property and it's not asserted. Either add a `dateField` to the view config and verify it's propagated, or update the test name to remove "dateField" since only appearance properties are being tested.

The test name mentions "propagates imageField, titleField" but the test view config doesn't include these properties and they're not asserted. Either add `imageField` and `titleField` to the view config and verify they're propagated, or update the test name to accurately reflect what is being tested (only appearance properties).

The test name mentions "propagates locationField" but the test view config doesn't include a `locationField` property and it's not asserted. Either add a `locationField` to the view config and verify it's propagated, or update the test name to accurately reflect what is being tested (only appearance properties).
